slides.title: FULL JOIN [[likho]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name, o.order_id
FROM customers c
FULL OUTER JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;

slides.title: Koi [[nahi chhoota]]
slides.note: + Aarav ka 103 bhi. Bina order wale **aur** ghost order, **dono** aaye 🤝

slides.title: MySQL ka [[jugaad]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name, o.order_id
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN
  orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id
UNION
SELECT c.name, o.order_id
FROM customers c RIGHT JOIN
  orders o ON c.id=o.customer_id;
slides.note: LEFT + RIGHT ko **UNION** se jodo. Duplicate match rows UNION hata deta

slides.wrong:
MySQL mein
FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ...
slides.right:
MySQL mein: LEFT JOIN ...
UNION
RIGHT JOIN ...
slides.why: MySQL **FULL OUTER JOIN support nahi** karta → syntax error
